vadsrijk.karakter.modus.normaal.uitleg: The normal adventure. Fainting costs nothing: you wake up at your last campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.eenvads.uitleg: One life! If you faint outside a town, your knight retires: they get a statue in the Hall of Resting Knights in Shroomsbury and rest there for good (you can't play them anymore). After that you can make a new One-Chonk knight on the right. While they live: a golden heart by your name and 10% more xp.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.knuffel.uitleg: Play the story at your own pace: monsters only do half their damage to you. You do get 10% less xp. A pink cloud by your name.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg: Each knight has their own levels, gear, quests and Chonk Coins. Clothes, mounts, pets and the bank are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.plek: You can only switch knights in a town or at a campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.arena: Not in the middle of a boss fight!
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.scene: Wait until the cutscene is over.
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.slot: Can't use that slot (taken or empty).
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.naam: Give your knight a name (letters and digits, max 16).
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.onder: Your knight gets a statue in the Hall of Resting Knights
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.iedereen: %s (%s) retires as a Resting Knight at level %s. A statue goes up in Shroomsbury!
vadsrijk.karakter.zaal.onder: They fainted once, and now rest with honor.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie: Characters: switch knight or make a new one
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.slots: You can have three knights: Normal on the left, Snuggle Mode in the middle, One-Chonk on the right. Use the ⚔ button next to your inventory!
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.vast: Every slot has a fixed game mode. It belongs to this knight and can never change.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.rust: Rests in the Hall of Resting Knights in Shroomsbury
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.welkom: Welcome to the Chonkdom! Choose how you want to play. You have three knights, each with a fixed game mode: Normal on the left, Snuggle Mode in the middle, One-Chonk on the right. Your own knight is ready on the left.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg_kort: Switch in a town or at a campfire. Clothes, mounts and pets are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.knop.uitleg: Characters: your knights (switch or make a new one)
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.rust: That knight rests in the Hall of Resting Knights. Make a new One-Chonk knight on the right!
vadsrijk.karakter.na_rust: You play on as %s. Your One-Chonk knight now stands in the Hall of Resting Knights; you can make a new one on the right.
vadsrijk.karakter.welkom.chat: You can always find your knights: the ⚔ button left of your inventory, the Knights tab, shift + right-click on a campfire, or talk to the Grandmaster, the Recruiter or a camp guard.
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.kampvuur: Shift + right-click a campfire to open your knights: switch or make a new one.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie.rekruteerder: Characters: what was that about three knights?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.8: Oh, one more thing! In the Chonkdom you can have three knights, each with a fixed way to play. On the left Normal, in the middle Snuggle Mode: monsters only hurt you half as much. And on the right One-Chonk: one life, and if you faint, you get a statue!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.9: A statue? And how do I choose?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.10: After the welcome scene, the screen opens by itself. Later you'll find your knights with the ⚔ button next to your inventory, with shift + right-click on a campfire, or at a camp guard. You can switch in a town or at a campfire. Wahoog, recruit!
